channel.title: Synapse Mfg notes
channel.description: Notes from the phones on cold calling and appointment setting for industrial manufacturers, from Synapse Mfg.

item.title: Outbound lead gen: a manufacturer's first week
item.description: Outbound lead generation for a manufacturer starts with a do-not-contact list and a screened call list, then a first week of daily calls, reviews and callbacks.

item.title: Cold Calling Not Working? Five Checks in Order
item.description: Cold calling isn't working when 15 to 30 full conversations book nothing. Check your numbers, the list, recordings, the script and the market, in that order.

item.title: Cold Calling vs Cold Email for Manufacturers
item.description: Call the contacts scored most likely to answer and buy, and email the rest: how manufacturers split cold calls and cold email, with our own reply rates.

item.title: First 30 Seconds of a Machine Shop Cold Call
item.description: What a machine shop salesperson says in the first 30 seconds of a cold call: permission line, one fit question, and when tolerances and certificates come in.

item.title: How to Find Out Who a Company Buys From
item.description: The question that makes a manufacturing buyer name their current supplier on a cold call, the moment in the call to ask it, and the four fields to log.

item.title: The First 90 Days of an In-House BDR
item.description: The first 90 days of an in-house BDR at a manufacturer, block by block, set against a dedicated outsourced salesperson, and the checks that show which one fits.

item.title: Machine Shop Sales Funnel: From RFQ to PO
item.description: The six stages between a cold call and a purchase order for a machine shop, what a buyer needs before you can quote, and how to time quote follow-up calls.

item.title: How Many Rebuttals on a Cold Call?
item.description: How many rebuttals a salesperson should use on a cold call to a manufacturing buyer, what each one sounds like, and when to stop and book a callback date.

item.title: Manufacturers' Rep Firm vs Hiring an SDR
item.description: A manufacturers' rep firm sells your line to buyers it already knows. An SDR calls the ones it doesn't. How to choose, and how to run both side by side.

item.title: The "We Already Have a Supplier" Objection
item.description: "We already have a supplier" hides two accounts: one solved, one mistimed. The question that sorts them, what to log, and which categories stay locked.

item.title: Cold Call Objections from Manufacturing Buyers
item.description: The five answers purchasing and engineering buyers give a cold call, what each one tells you about the account, and what to log so the callback lands.
